name: Local AI Lab Audit
audience: Founders and operators running private/local AI labs on their own hardware.
pain: Hidden GPU bottlenecks, thermal headroom misuse, and model-routing inefficiency that waste money and burn uptime.
offer: A one-day on-site audit of your local AI lab: ranked findings, a repair plan with owner + effort, and an APVA ROI estimate with optional dashboard setup.
headline: Find and fix the hidden bottlenecks in your local AI lab in one day.
founding_cohort: First 10 audits at $499; standard rate rises after general availability.

faq.a: GPU utilization and VRAM routing, thermal headroom, disk pressure, service health, and throughput per dollar for the workloads you actually run.
A PDF/Markdown audit report with ranked fixes, an APVA ROI estimate, and (optional) dashboard setup on your machine.
